connector.name: Anchor X402
connector.registryDescription: x402-paid agent tools: 18 over HTTP, 14 over stdio. USDC per call, no API key.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.anchor-x402.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package anchor-x402-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hypeprinter007-stack account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ANCHOR_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: EVM private key (0x-prefixed hex). The wallet pays for x402 calls in USDC on Base mainnet. Fund with USDC before use.
